MAJOR: AC-1 tension: the delta makes the on-mode unlisted path open/write a file (`PF_BACKLOG_METRICS_FILE`) in `_raise_unlisted`, and `test_ac2_unlisted_metric_export` asserts that file write — contradicting AC-1 "instead of reading or writing files" and the design invariant "On + unlisted never touches files". Textfile counter semantics are not alert-grade: `_DB_UNLISTED_COUNT` is process-local, rewritten with mode `"w"` on every raise, so any second worker/instance sharing one path clobbers the value (count goes backwards) and restarts reset it; `increase(backlog_db_scope_unlisted_total[10m]) >= 3` then pages on noise or misses sustained failures. Needs monotonic, process-qualified export (or per-process metric names).

SUMMARY: The delta substantively resolves the prior observability MAJOR by adding a real exported counter and a sustained-failure alert, but introduces a contract conflict (file write on the very path AC-1 says must not touch files) and a non-monotonic, clobber-prone textfile counter that undermines the new page alert.
